english.meaning: part of the saying 上得山多終遇虎: if you take risks often enough, you will meet a tiger in the end, meaning it catches up with you
english.note: This meaning is less certain: it was read from a few recorded conversations.

exampleSentences.english: Back to the same old mistake. Go into the mountains often enough and you’ll eventually meet a tiger, right?
exampleSentences.traditional: 重蹈覆轍。上得山多𠻺終遇虎，係唔係先？
